BT11_112_official_QA.question: When one of my Digimon with [Veedramon] in its name without a [When Digivolving] effect becomes suspended, can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect?

BT11_112_official_QA.answer:
Yes, you can.
If activated, you must activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before you can activate this card's [All Turns] effect.
Additionally, even if the digivolved card is a Digimon without [Veedramon] in its name, you can still activate that card's [When Digivolving] effect.
